items.title: 19.10 Stereochemistry in Drug Development (dawa banane mein stereochemistry) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 19.10, PDF page 56.

blocks.text: Pharmaceutical products (dawaiyan) banane mein chirality aik bohat ahem feature (khoobi) hai jo dawa ki safety (hifazat) aur efficacy (asar) tay karti hai. Biological system (jaandaar jism) chiral building blocks (ajza) se bana hai, aur dawa ke receptors bohat specific (makhsoos) “chiral locks” (chiral taale) ki tarah kaam karte hain: sirf sahi shakal wali “chaabi” fit hoti hai. Is liye chiral dawa ke do enantiomers ka asar aksar bohat alag hota hai.

blocks.alt: Thalidomide: benzene ka ring (andar circle) aik paanch atom wale ring se jura jis mein do C=O groups aur aik N hai. Yeh N dashed bond se aik chhe atom wale ring ke carbon se jura hai jis mein bhi do C=O groups aur aik N-H hai; is carbon par thos wedge par H hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 19.7: Thalidomide (kitab ki Figure 19.7 ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Dashed bond ke daen sire wala ring carbon chiral hai: is par H, N aur ring ke do alag carbon (aik C=O ki taraf, aik CH₂ ki taraf) jure hain. Is liye thalidomide ke do enantiomers hain. Dawa racemic mixture ki shakal mein bechi gayi thi, aur jism mein pure (khalis) (+) isomer bhi jaldi racemic ho jata hai.

Thalidomide aik tranquilliser (sukoon dene wali dawa) thi jo shuru mein racemic mixture ki shakal mein bechi gayi (Figure 19.7). Yeh bohat kamyab aur non-toxic (ghair zehreeli) sedative lagti thi jis ke koi side-effects maloom na the. Lekin 1960 ki decade (dahai) ke shuru mein pata chala ke jin auraton ne pregnancy (hamal) ke shuru ke dinon mein nausea (matli, “morning sickness”) ke liye yeh dawa li thi, un ke bachche shadeed deformities (jismani naqais) ke saath paida hue. Dawa foran market se wapas le li gayi.

Research (tehqeeq) se pata chala ke (+) isomer asar wala aur mehfooz tranquilliser tha, jab ke (−) isomer pet mein bachche (fetus) ko nuqsan pohanchata tha. Pehle samjha gaya ke kuch batches mein (−) isomer ki contamination (milawat) masla thi, lekin baad ki research ne dikhaya ke pure (+) isomer khoon mein jate hi tezi se racemise ho jata hai (yani (+) aur (−) ka mixture ban jata hai): 10 minute mein racemisation 50% se zyada complete ho jati hai. Thalidomide ke aise milte julte compounds (analogues) jin ki chirality stable rehti hai, inflammation (sozish) ki dawa ke taur par test kiye ja rahe hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab kehti hai ke thalidomide dobara kabhi market nahi hogi. Darasal thalidomide baad mein sakht restrictions (pabandiyon) ke saath, jo pregnancy mein is ka istemal rokti hain, dobara approve hui: USA mein 1998 mein leprosy ki aik complication (pecheedgi) ke liye aur 2006 mein khoon ke cancer multiple myeloma ke liye.

blocks.prompt: Thalidomide ka sirf mehfooz (+) isomer bechna kyun kaafi nahi tha?
blocks.explanation: (+) isomer khoon mein bohat jaldi racemise ho jata hai (10 minute mein 50% se zyada), is liye nuqsan wala (−) isomer jism mein phir bhi ban jata hai.

items: Receptors chiral hain, is liye dawa ke do enantiomers ka asar bohat alag ho sakta hai.
Isi liye racemic mixtures ko alag karna parta hai, ya chiral catalysts se sirf aik pure optical isomer banaya jata hai.
Thalidomide: (−) isomer ne pet ke bachche ko nuqsan diya; (+) isomer jism mein racemise ho jata hai.
